name: Swash
author: Erin Carter
description: Dozens of thin diagonal streaks of light flow in parallel lanes across the frame like a travelling current, each dash scrolling steadily off one edge while new ones enter the other, lanes drifting at staggered speeds. Palette-graded from a bright head to a dim tail, bold and crisp against the near-black.

params.label: Flow speed
params.effect: How fast the streaks flow along their lanes and off the frame; 0 stills the current, high sends them racing through.

params.label: Lane spacing
params.effect: Perpendicular CSS-pixel distance between streak lanes; small = dense etched field, large = sparse isolated strokes.

params.label: Streak length
params.effect: CSS-pixel length of each light streak from bright head to faded tail; longer strokes fill more of each lane.

params.label: Stroke thickness
params.effect: Half-thickness of each streak in CSS pixels — thin gives hairline etching, thick gives bold crisp diagonal bars.

params.label: Lane angle
params.effect: Angle of the lanes in degrees — 0 is a horizontal drift, 90 a vertical fall, anything between a diagonal rake.
